label: early x/t/3 input (positions 1-3) after a d/u/s/p-like token
predicate: (phase == 0) & (t >= 1) & (t <= 3) & isin(in_tok, [tok("x"), tok("t"), tok("3")]) & (n_seen([tok("d"), tok("u"), tok("s"), tok("p"), tok("t"), tok("x"), tok("r"), tok("y"), tok("i")]) >= 1)
explanation: Fires only in the original-input phase, almost entirely at steps 1-3 (step 2 holds ~58% of mass; never at step 0, essentially never at step 5+, the delimiter, or the copy phase). The input token is mostly x, t or 3 (~81% of mass), with weaker firing on r, y, p, i, h, 1, 2 etc. Magnitude depends on the earlier prefix tokens: a preceding d, u, s, p, t (also r, y, i) raises it, and the strongest activations are d d x / d d 3 / d t x. The same x/t/3 at step 1-3 after other prefixes (b, l, v, z, h ...) is often silent, so precision stays around 0.6. It behaves like a graded sum of position, current-token and prefix-token contributions, and no clean boolean rule captures it. Mostly on the first occurrence of the token.
